title: Fighting by moonlight: did the Moon decide when battles were fought?
excerpt: D-Day and El Alamein were timed by the Moon. I worked out the Moon over 9,877 battles from Wikidata, correcting the calendars as I went: battles fall on every phase almost equally.
seo_description: The phase of the Moon on the day of 9,877 battles, from Hastings to D-Day: did commanders fight by moonlight? Mostly not.
header_alt: Title card on parchment reading 'Fighting by moonlight' in black and red lettering beside a ring of eight drawings of the Moon's phases, with the line 'The Moon over nearly ten thousand battles, from Hastings to D-Day'.
